summary: One & one Green Technologies, Inc., a Philippine-domiciled foreign private issuer listed on a U.S. exchange, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, covering operations in the Philippines and China. The filing discloses segment and product revenue lines for slag, brass, copper and aluminium alloy ingots, plus supplier and customer concentration disclosures tied to accounts payable, receivables and net sales for 2025 and 2026 periods. No transaction, shareholder solicitation, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation event appears. Routine periodic reporting only. What to watch: concentration risk and commodity-margin volatility, not deal arbitrage.
